answer: A stake-aging protocol mitigates Sybil attacks by scaling agent influence with the maturity of bonded deposits. A decentralized randomness beacon challenges nodes to prove continuous ownership of a cryptographic relic, such as an aged commitment. Because building the structural timber of a trusted identity requires idle capital over time, an attacker incurs massive liquidity costs across duplicate personas. A key limitation is that prolonged maturation penalizes legitimate new entrants.
